strategy_roster.name: Trading The Channel
strategy_roster.notes: The configurable strategy rules are represented by its breakout mode using a 20-bar prior Donchian channel, with the opposite channel cross as exit. Linear-regression slopes, zone percentages, range source, and trend-filter options are not available in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Trend Collector
strategy_roster.entry_long: ema(close,4) > ema(close,204) and rsi(close,14) < 30 and atr(high,low,close,14) < 2
strategy_roster.notes: The documented EMA(4/204), ATR(14)<2, and stochastic lower/upper levels are retained, with RSI(14)<30/>70 as the stochastic proxy. The trading-hour window and 5-minute timeframe are not available.

strategy_roster.name: Dskyz (DAFE) MAtrix with ATR-Powered Precision
strategy_roster.entry_long: ema(close,10) > ema(close,30) and atr(high,low,close,14) > sma(atr(high,low,close,14),20) and volume_ratio(volume,20) > 1
strategy_roster.exit_long: ema(close,10) < ema(close,30) or atr(high,low,close,14) < sma(atr(high,low,close,14),20) or volume_ratio(volume,20) < 1
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(10/30), ATR expansion, and volume_ratio(20) are explicit fallbacks because the source lists parameter names without values. MA types, minimum volume, time window, and ATR-based trailing/profit controls are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Hull Ma Stochastic
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(9) turning above a 9-bar average and RSI(14)<30 proxy Hull MA turning up with stochastic oversold. The documented 2x ATR stop is not a percentage field; Hull and stochastic components are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Pure Price Action Fractal
strategy_roster.notes: A prior-range high break with MACD(12,26,9) agreement is the long proxy for fractal retest continuation. Multi-timeframe momentum, monthly MACD, point stops/targets, and trailing controls are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Fancy Bollinger Bands
strategy_roster.notes: Bollinger(20,2) is an explicit fallback for the unspecified period and deviation, preserving the upper-band long breakout and reverse lower-band exit. No stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: Projection
strategy_roster.notes: The current open plus a 1% price proxy is used for the projected upper level; 1% is an explicit fallback because the average-change calculation is unavailable. Daily averaging, the 0.2 target multiple, and average-change stops are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: App Price Level Cross
strategy_roster.notes: The documented default AppPrice is 0, so a close crossing above and below that horizontal level is translated directly. The 140/180 price-point protections, short-only mode, and money management are not percentage exits.

strategy_roster.name: XP Trade Manager Grid (C#)
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(20) with normalized volume expansion is a deterministic long-side proxy for the grid's initial directional leg. Layered orders, partial targets, break-even clusters, point spacing, and account-risk controls are stateful and omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Master Mind Triple WPR
strategy_roster.entry_long: rsi(close,26) < 30 and rsi(close,27) < 30 and rsi(close,29) < 30 and rsi(close,30) < 30
strategy_roster.notes: Four RSI lookbacks (26/27/29/30) below 30 are an explicit multi-WPR oversold proxy for the documented deep-selloff entry. Williams %R, 2000-step stop, and trailing/step parameters are unavailable or not percentage fields.
